raw_text: We saw good retention, low attrition after our price changes.
We are seeing good mix shift. I shared that the mid-market grew approximately 42%, and that is driving the improvements and should continue for the remainder of the year.
We are seeing good progress serving mid-market customers in Mailchimp but are seeing higher churn from smaller customers.
We've also added over 200 account managers, business development folks that are very geared towards outside selling and that is contributing to where we are today.
Our gross margin improved to 92% this quarter
We already have 800,000 mid-market customers in our franchise, who can grow into our QBO Advanced and Intuit Enterprise Suite offerings.
In fiscal year 2024, QBO Advanced customers moved 28% online ecosystem revenue grew 36%, and ecosystem ARPC was 5x that of the rest of the QBO base.
Total online payment volume growth in Q1 was 17%.
After successfully piloting Intuit Assist with over two million customers, it is now generally available to all US QuickBooks online customers.
Total revenue for the Q1 2025 was $2 billion
